```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div style={{
        width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
        maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
        height: '180px',
        overflowX: 'auto',
        overflowY: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
        position: 'relative' as const,
      }}>
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
          onClick={handleTimelineClick}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedClipId(clip.id)}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close scrollable container */}
      </div> {/* Close timelineWrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Styles
 */
const styles = {
  container: {
    marginTop: '0', // Remove top margin

    borderRadius: '0', // Remove border radius for full width
```

```typescriptreact
/**

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging

  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {

  useEffect(() => {

      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);

    }

  return (
```

Perfect! The app should hot-reload. Here's the simple fix:

---

## ✅ **FIXED: Viewport-Locked Width**

### **The Simple Solution:**

**Changed wrapper width from:**
- `width: '100%'` (relative to parent - can expand!)

**To:**
- `width: '100vw'` (100% of viewport - ABSOLUTE!)
- `maxWidth: '100vw'` (can never exceed viewport)

### **Why This Works:**

- `100vw` = 100% of the **browser viewport width** (the actual window)
- It's an **absolute** measurement, not relative to any parent
- `maxWidth: '100vw'` ensures it can never exceed that
- The canvas inside can be any width - the wrapper scrolls it

---

## 🎯 **Now Test:**

**Zoom In** (🔍+): Wrapper stays locked at 100vw, canvas scrolls inside ✅  
**Zoom Out** (🔍−): Canvas fits, no expansion ✅

The wrapper is now **absolutely locked** to the viewport width! 🔒

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div style={{
        width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
        maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
        height: '180px',
        overflowX: 'auto',
        overflowY: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
        position: 'relative' as const,
      }}>
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
          onClick={handleTimelineClick}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedClipId(clip.id)}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Styles
 */
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div 
        style={{
          width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
          maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
          height: '180px',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          overflowY: 'hidden',
          backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
          position: 'relative' as const,
        }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} // Mouse wheel zoom control
      >
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
          onClick={handleTimelineClick}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedClipId(clip.id)}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

Perfect! The app should hot-reload now. Let me explain what I've added:

---

## ✅ **Mouse Wheel Zoom Control Added!**

### **New Feature:**

**Hover over the timeline tracks and scroll:**
- **Scroll UP** (toward you) → **Zoom IN** (🔍+)
- **Scroll DOWN** (away from you) → **Zoom OUT** (🔍−)

### **Implementation:**

1. **`handleWheel` function**: Detects mouse wheel direction
   - `e.deltaY < 0` = scrolling up = zoom in (+1)
   - `e.deltaY > 0` = scrolling down = zoom out (-1)
   - `e.preventDefault()` prevents page scrolling

2. **`onWheel` handler**: Attached to the timeline wrapper div
   - Only triggers when mouse is over the timeline area
   - Same fine-grained zoom control as buttons (±1 px/sec)

### **Zoom Controls Summary:**

| Method | Zoom In | Zoom Out |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **Buttons** | 🔍+ | 🔍− |
| **Mouse Wheel** | Scroll ↑ | Scroll ↓ |
| **Range** | 0.5 - 30 px/sec | 0.5 - 30 px/sec |

---

## 🎯 **Test It Out:**

1. **Import a video** to see the timeline
2. **Hover your mouse** over the timeline area (the gray tracks)
3. **Scroll your mouse wheel**:
   - UP → Timeline zooms in (clips expand)
   - DOWN → Timeline zooms out (clips shrink)
4. The wrapper stays locked at viewport width, content scrolls horizontally when zoomed in!

This gives you smooth, intuitive zoom control right where you need it! 🎬✨

**User**

Much nicer!  When I click on a track (not on the ruler) the playhead moves there - it should not move unless I am dragging it by its 'head' or click a point on the ruler

**Cursor**

Good catch! Let's fix that. The issue is that the `onClick` handler on the timeline canvas is triggering for all clicks. We need to make it only work when clicking the ruler, not the tracks.

Now let me look at where the ruler is rendered and where the click handler is attached:

Perfect! I can see the issue. The `onClick={handleTimelineClick}` is on the entire timeline canvas (line 214), but it should only be on the ruler. Let's fix this:

Now we also need to make sure clips don't trigger the ruler click, so let's add `stopPropagation` to the clip onClick:

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div 
        style={{
          width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
          maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
          height: '180px',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          overflowY: 'hidden',
          backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
          position: 'relative' as const,
        }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} // Mouse wheel zoom control
      >
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler} onClick={handleTimelineClick}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent ruler click
                    setSelectedClipId(clip.id);
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

 */
```

Perfect! The app should hot-reload. Here's what I fixed:

---

## ✅ **Fixed: Playhead Only Moves on Ruler Click**

### **Changes Made:**

1. **Moved `onClick` handler from timeline canvas to ruler only**
   - **Before**: `onClick` was on the entire canvas (ruler + tracks)
   - **After**: `onClick` is ONLY on the ruler div

2. **Added `stopPropagation` to clip clicks**
   - When clicking a clip, it now prevents the click from bubbling up to the ruler
   - This ensures clips can still be selected without moving the playhead

### **New Behavior:**

| Click Target | Playhead Moves? | Action |
|--------------|-----------------|--------|
| **Ruler** | ✅ Yes | Sets playhead to clicked time |
| **Clip** | ❌ No | Selects the clip |
| **Empty track area** | ❌ No | Nothing happens |
| **Playhead handle** | ✅ Yes (drag) | Drags playhead to new position |

---

## 🎯 **Test It:**

1. **Click on the ruler** (top time bar) → Playhead jumps there ✅
2. **Click on a clip** → Clip gets selected (golden border), playhead stays put ✅
3. **Click on empty track area** → Nothing happens ✅
4. **Drag the playhead handle** → Playhead moves smoothly ✅

Now you have precise control over when the playhead moves! 🎬

**Cursor**

Perfect! Let's make the entire playhead (both the handle and the line) draggable. I'll add the mouse down handler to both elements.

I see! The `onMouseDown` is already on the parent `div` that contains both the handle and the line, so it should already be draggable from anywhere. But let's also update the cursor style to show that the entire playhead is draggable, not just the parent div:

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div 
        style={{
          width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
          maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
          height: '180px',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          overflowY: 'hidden',
          backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
          position: 'relative' as const,
        }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} // Mouse wheel zoom control
      >
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler} onClick={handleTimelineClick}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent ruler click
                    setSelectedClipId(clip.id);
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
            cursor: isDraggingPlayhead ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

Now let's also update the styles to ensure the playhead line has proper pointer events and cursor:

I see the issue! The `playhead` parent has `pointerEvents: 'none'`, and only the handle has `pointerEvents: 'auto'`. We need to add `pointerEvents: 'auto'` to the line as well, and update the cursor style:

**Cursor**

Excellent debugging! You've found a critical alignment issue. The problem is likely in how we're calculating positions - there's a mismatch between the ruler offset and the clip/playhead positioning. Let me investigate and fix this.

Now let me check where the ruler marks, clips, and playhead are positioned:

Perfect! I can see the issue. Look at the positioning:

- **Ruler marks**: `left: ${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px` (line 222)
- **Clips**: `left: ${clip.startTime * zoom + 50}px` (line 235)
- **Playhead**: `left: ${currentTime * zoom + 50}px` (line 280)

Everything has `+ 50` offset, which is correct. But let me check the `tracksContainer` style - it might have padding that's causing the misalignment:

Wait, let me also check the `timelineCanvas` style - it might have padding that's affecting the ruler click calculations:

**FOUND IT!** The problem is on line 389:

```typescript
padding: '0 15px', // Match contentWrapper padding
```

The `timelineCanvas` has 15px horizontal padding, which means:
- The ruler marks, clips, and playhead all add their `50px` offset
- But the canvas itself has an ADDITIONAL `15px` padding on the left
- So the visual elements are actually at `15px + 50px = 65px` from the left edge of the canvas
- But when we calculate click positions, we're using `getBoundingClientRect()` on the canvas and only subtracting `50px`, not accounting for the `15px` padding!

Let me fix this by removing the padding from `timelineCanvas` and adjusting the offset constant:

```typescript
padding: '0 15px', // Match contentWrapper padding
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div 
        style={{
          width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
          maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
          height: '180px',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          overflowY: 'hidden',
          backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
          position: 'relative' as const,
        }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} // Mouse wheel zoom control
      >
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler} onClick={handleTimelineClick}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent ruler click
                    setSelectedClipId(clip.id);
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
            cursor: isDraggingPlayhead ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Styles
 */
const styles = {
  container: {

    borderRadius: '0', // Remove border radius for full width
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * ClipForge - Timeline Component
 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls
 */

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

// Timeline left offset for visual alignment
const TIMELINE_LEFT_OFFSET = 20;

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50; // Subtract left padding
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          {/* Zoom Controls */}
          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomOut} title="Zoom Out">
              🔍−
            </button>
            <span style={styles.zoomLabel}>{Math.round(zoom)}px/s</span>
            <button style={styles.zoomButton} onClick={handleZoomIn} title="Zoom In">
              🔍+
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Timeline Canvas Wrapper - Fixed Width */}
      <div 
        style={{
          width: '100vw', // 100% of viewport width
          maxWidth: '100vw', // Never exceed viewport
          height: '180px',
          overflowX: 'auto',
          overflowY: 'hidden',
          backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa',
          position: 'relative' as const,
        }}
        onWheel={handleWheel} // Mouse wheel zoom control
      >
        {/* Timeline Canvas - Content */}
        <div
          ref={timelineRef}
          style={{
            ...styles.timelineCanvas,
            // Width: at least wrapper width, max 5x wrapper width for reasonable scrolling
            width: `${Math.max(
              window.innerWidth,
              Math.min(totalDuration * zoom + 100, window.innerWidth * 5)
            )}px`,
          }}
        >
        {/* Time Ruler */}
        <div style={styles.ruler} onClick={handleTimelineClick}>
          {Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(totalDuration / 10) + 1 }, (_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              style={{
                ...styles.rulerMark,
                left: `${i * 10 * zoom + 50}px`,
              }}
            >
              <span style={styles.rulerLabel}>{formatTime(i * 10)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,
                    left: `${clipLeft}px`,
                    width: `${clipWidth}px`,
                    ...(isSelected ? styles.clipSelected : {}),
                  }}
                  title={clip.metadata.filename}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation(); // Prevent ruler click
                    setSelectedClipId(clip.id);
                  }}
                >
                  {/* Clip Content */}
                  <div style={styles.clipHeader}>
                    <span style={styles.clipName}>{clip.metadata.filename}</span>
                    <button
                      style={styles.removeButton}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        removeClip(clip.id);
                      }}
                      title="Remove clip"
                    >
                      ✕
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
            cursor: isDraggingPlayhead ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * Styles
 */
const styles = {
```

```typescriptreact
/**

 * Visual timeline with clips, playhead, and controls

import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTimeline } from '../../context/TimelineContext';

// Timeline left offset for visual alignment
const TIMELINE_LEFT_OFFSET = 20;

export const Timeline: React.FC = () => {
  const { timelineState, setCurrentTime, setZoom, removeClip, splitClipAtTime } = useTimeline();
  const { clips, totalDuration, currentTime, zoom } = timelineState;
  
  const timelineRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingPlayhead, setIsDraggingPlayhead] = useState(false);
  const [selectedClipId, setSelectedClipId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /**
   * Format time in MM:SS format
   */
  const formatTime = (seconds: number): string => {
    const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
    return `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  /**
   * Handle playback (simple timer-based for MVP)
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPlaying) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      const newTime = currentTime + 0.1;
      
      if (newTime >= totalDuration) {
        setIsPlaying(false);
        setCurrentTime(0); // Loop back to start
      } else {
        setCurrentTime(newTime);
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isPlaying, totalDuration, currentTime, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Handle timeline click to set playhead position
   */
  const handleTimelineClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!timelineRef.current) return;

    const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left - TIMELINE_LEFT_OFFSET; // Subtract left offset
    const clickedTime = Math.max(0, clickX / zoom);
    
    setCurrentTime(Math.min(clickedTime, totalDuration));
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse down on playhead for dragging
   */
  const handlePlayheadMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setIsDraggingPlayhead(true);
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse move for playhead dragging
   */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isDraggingPlayhead) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!timelineRef.current) return;

      const rect = timelineRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left - 50;
      const newTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(mouseX / zoom, totalDuration));
      
      setCurrentTime(newTime);
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingPlayhead(false);
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingPlayhead, zoom, totalDuration, setCurrentTime]);

  /**
   * Toggle playback
   */
  const togglePlayback = () => {
    if (currentTime >= totalDuration) {
      setCurrentTime(0);
    }
    setIsPlaying((prev) => !prev);
  };

  /**
   * Handle zoom controls (finer increments: ±1 px/sec)
   */
  const handleZoomIn = () => setZoom(zoom + 1);
  const handleZoomOut = () => setZoom(zoom - 1);

  /**
   * Handle split at playhead
   */
  const handleSplit = () => {
    const splitTime = currentTime; // Capture current time
    const wasSplit = splitClipAtTime(splitTime);
    if (wasSplit) {
      console.log('✅ Split successful at time:', splitTime);
      // Maintain playhead position after split
      setCurrentTime(splitTime);
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No clip to split at playhead position');
    }
  };

  /**
   * Handle mouse wheel zoom
   */
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); // Prevent page scroll
    
    const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1; // Scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out
    setZoom(zoom + zoomDelta);
  };

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      {/* Timeline Header */}
      <div style={styles.header}>
        <h3 style={styles.title}>Timeline</h3>
        <div style={styles.controls}>
          {/* Playback Controls */}
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={togglePlayback}
            title={isPlaying ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
          >
            {isPlaying ? '⏸️' : '▶️'}
          </button>
          <button
            style={styles.controlButton}
            onClick={() => setCurrentTime(0)}
            title="Reset to start"
          >
            ⏮️
          </button>

          {/* Split Button */}
          <button
            style={{
              ...styles.controlButton,
              backgroundColor: '#dc3545',
            }}
            onClick={handleSplit}
            title="Split clip at playhead (✂️)"
          >
            ✂️ Split
          </button>
          
          {/* Time Display */}
          <span style={styles.timeDisplay}>
            {formatTime(currentTime)} / {formatTime(totalDuration)}
          </span>

          <div style={styles.zoomControls}>

      <div

            width: `${Math.max(

            )}px`,

        </div>

        {/* Clips */}
        <div style={styles.tracksContainer}>
          <div style={styles.track}>
            {clips.map((clip) => {
              const clipWidth = clip.duration * zoom;
              const clipLeft = clip.startTime * zoom + 50;
              const isSelected = selectedClipId === clip.id;

              return (
                <div
                  key={clip.id}
                  style={{
                    ...styles.clip,

                  <div style={styles.clipInfo}>
                    {formatTime(clip.duration)}

                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Playhead */}
        <div
          style={{
            ...styles.playhead,
            left: `${currentTime * zoom + 50}px`,
            cursor: isDraggingPlayhead ? 'grabbing' : 'grab',
          }}
          onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown}
        >
          <div style={styles.playheadHandle} />
          <div style={styles.playheadLine} onMouseDown={handlePlayheadMouseDown} />
        </div>
      </div> {/* Close timelineCanvas */}
      </div> {/* Close wrapper */}

      {/* Timeline Info */}
      <div style={styles.info}>
        <p style={styles.infoText}>
          {clips.length === 0 ? (
            '📹 Import videos to get started'
          ) : (
            `📹 ${clips.length} clip(s) • Total duration: ${formatTime(totalDuration)}`
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```
